question: Who among the following was a Portuguese writer who wrote about the trade and society in south India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Duarte Barbosa.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Duarte Barbosa**__

 __
 
• He was a **Portuguese writer and officer from Portuguese India.**
 
• He was a **Christian pastor and scrivener** in a feitoria in Kochi.
 
• His Book of **Duarte Barbosa** is one of the **earliest examples of Portuguese travel literature.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Niccolao Manucci**__

 __
 
• ​He was a **Venetian writer, doctor, and traveller.**
 
• He wrote a first-hand account of the Mughal Empire.
 
• He is famous for his work **"Storia do Mogor"**, an account of Mughal history and life.
 
 
 
• **Jean-Baptiste Tavernier**__
 __
 
• He was a 17th-century French gem **merchant and traveller.**
 
• He is best known for his 1666 discovery or purchase of the 116-carat Tavernier Blue diamond.
 
 
 
• **Francois Bernier**__
 
 
• ​He was a **French physician and traveller.**
 
• He wrote Travels in the **Mughal Empire which is about the reigns of Dara Shikoh and Aurangzeb.**
